say:1:1123511001:1.text: Hashir, you're looking full of energy! Healthy as a snow stomper!
say:1:1123511001:1.source_cn: 哈什尔先生，您看起来精神了不少！

say:2:1123511002:1.text: Oh, really? It's probably because these blubbering bears have me running around yelling at them all day!
say:2:1123511002:1.source_cn: 哈，是吗。\n也许是被那帮笨蛋熊人气的吧！

choice_prompt:3:1123511002.text: Oh, really? It's probably because these blubbering bears have me running around yelling at them all day!
choice_prompt:3:1123511002.source_cn: 哈，是吗。\n也许是被那帮笨蛋熊人气的吧！

say:4:1123511003:1.text: As you can see, I've decided to pass on everything I know to the clan. I've still got some worth until I've finished teaching these idiots.
say:4:1123511003:1.source_cn: 如你所见，我已经决定要把自己所会的东西在氏族内传承下去...
say:4:1123511003:1.male: As you can see, I've decided to pass on everything I know to the clan. I've still got some worth until I've finished teaching these idiots.
say:4:1123511003:1.female: As you can see, I've decided to pass on everything I know to the clan. I've still got some worth until I've finished teaching these idiots.

say:6:1123511004:1.text: Your training is excellent! Your words are concise and practical. It's easy for us to figure out what were doing wrong.
say:6:1123511004:1.source_cn: 真是精彩的教导！你讲的话简练实用，很快就能知道该怎么化...

say:7:1123511005:1.text: It's a pity that I came too late. My newly established clan really needs a sage like you.
say:7:1123511005:1.source_cn: 真是可惜……我来的太晚了，我新创立的氏族十分缺你这种智...

say:8:1123511006:1.text: I'm no sage. All I have is experience.
say:8:1123511006:1.source_cn: 什么智慧，无非都是些经验罢了。

say:10:1123511007:1.text: Hashir will always be one of us. That's what I've been saying all this time.
say:10:1123511007:1.source_cn: 我一直在说，哈什尔是黑嚎氏族的成员，他永远都是。

say:12:1123511008:1.text: Hey... Why are you looking at the magister?
say:12:1123511008:1.male: Hey... Why are you looking at the magister?
say:12:1123511008:1.female: Hey... Why are you looking at the magister?

say:13:1123511009:1.text: Ha! It's nothing. I wanted to say that even outlanders can be part of our clan too...
say:13:1123511009:1.source_cn: 呵呵，没什么，我想说即使是异族之人，也能是我们黑嚎的成员……
